exposure: invasive Group B Streptococcus (GBS) infection during infancy
cohort: All children born alive in Norway during 1996-2012 were included in the study.
finding: Invasive GBS infection was associated with a significantly increased risk of infant mortality (OR 24.5; 95% CI: 18.0-33.3) and cerebral palsy (OR 22.9; 95% CI: 15.1-34.5) compared to the background population.
